about: POST /gameday/set requests and the settings they leave in /gameday/state.
Checked against the firmware's parser (components/gameday/set_request.h) by test_set.cpp
and against tests/web/mock_device.py by its --selftest, so the page's mock can't drift.
Each case starts from base plus its own start, sends set (key, value pairs, applied in
kSetKeys order) and compares the keys in expect. Teams are written league:id, "" for none.
status 400: no key in the request is one the firmware takes, so nothing changes.
The panel keeps the saved team's league byte after the team is cleared, and a fresh panel's
is NFL, so Live auto counts that league too (team_league in start sets it).
follow is the Follow this game pin, kept in memory only. board (start only) says the mode
has a game of its own on the panel to follow: not Live games' fallback card or finals, nor
an empty board, and final (start only) that its game has ended. A new team or mode, any
favorites post or new leagues let the pin go.
idle is the idle display (0 next game, 1 clock, 2 scores, 3 my team today, 4 off or dim),
idledim its dim level (0 dark), night the night hours with nightstart and nightend (HH:MM,
24-hour) and nightbri their brightness.
bets lists the manual bets by slot as entered: slot, league, team id, type (spread, over,
under or ml) and the line in half points (-7 is -3.5). The state document adds each bet's
game and status, which the comparison leaves out. bet= into slot 0 takes the first empty
slot, what the device page sends, and with every slot in use changes nothing.
visit is another game's big play on the board for a moment (watch.h). board and final then
describe the mode's own game, which follow=1 follows while it hasn't ended, ending the visit;
watch=0 and a new team or mode end it too.
players lists the favorite players in slot order: league, ESPN athlete id, team id and the
panel's name. player= puts one in the first empty slot (the same league and id again keeps
its slot and takes the new team and name), and with every slot in use changes nothing.
playerdel=<league>,<id> drops one. Start players are listed in the order of their slots.
rotate is Switch every (and Alternate every) in whole minutes, rotatesec the same setting in
seconds: 30, or whole minutes. 30 seconds shows as rotate 1. A start with rotate alone
means that many minutes.
split is what the second area shows (0 off, 1 rotating live games, 2 a second team's game,
3 today's scores, 4 clock and date, 5 the board's Game Day, then 6 F1, 7 stocks and crypto and
8 flights), one digit and nothing else; splitteam its team, never a golf tour, a racing series
or the panel's own team, "none" or "" clearing it.
display is what the main area shows (0 Game Day, 1 F1, 2 stocks and crypto, 3 flights), one
digit. displays (start only) lists the ones the firmware has, Game Day alone unless it says;
display and split refuse a display it lacks.
clocksize and textsize are Clock size and Text size, 0 Normal or 1 Large, one digit and
nothing else.
props lists the player prop bets by slot as entered: slot, league, ESPN athlete id, team id,
the panel's name, the stat's key, side (over, under or yes) and the line in half points (0 for
a yes prop). prop= into slot 0 takes the first empty slot and with every slot in use changes
nothing; propdel=<slot> empties one. ESPN leagues only, as for favorite players. A prop slot is
1 to 16 written plainly, one or two digits with no sign, space or leading zero.
markets lists the stocks and crypto display's symbols by slot: symbol and kind (stock, index
or crypto). Its keys count only when displays has 2, after the panel's own: mkt=<slot>,<symbol>
with an optional kind (slot 0 adds one at the end, a listed slot takes the new symbol, one
already listed keeps its slot, a ninth is refused), mktdel=<slot> and mktmove=<from>,<to>.
Until a list is saved it shows SPY, AAPL, BTC and ETH, and an edit starts from those.
flights (Flight Tracker, display 3) is its own settings: home as lat,lon to four places ("" none),
place the name the page found it by, radius with radius_unit (mi, km or nm; capped at 250 mi,
400 km or 200 nm), receiver the owner's ADS-B receiver address, and units, imperial in the US
and UK time zones and metric elsewhere. Its keys flyhome, flyplace, flyradius and flyreceiver
come after kSetKeys and only when displays has 3; flyhome=none clears the place too.
